Question: Select the best translation into predicate logic. Some CEO is wealthier than everyone. (Cx: x is a CEO; Px: x is a person; Wxy: x is wealthier than y)

Options: 
A. (∃x)[Cx • (∀y)(Py • Wxy)]

D. (∀x)[Px ⊃ (∃y)(Cy ⊃ Wxy)]

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
